additional_info.body:
Dear
Filomena Carusone
,
We are sending this email regarding a problem with your charger:
MP / R9 170002644
which led to the opened ticket:
0465381
.
Error description:
"Is it possible to check logs on the charger 170002644 on today 2 of December at 5:06:32 p.m. (CU Time) ?A customer tried to charge with Type 2 plug, but it was a 0 recharge.
Thank you in advance"
According to the charger configurations the error was in the plug AC:
The logs have been downloaded and attached to the ticket, it was possible to observe that the plug was never connected:
2025-12-02T17:06:32.619847+00:00 [FW080005G1] sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/98f22f472b97[827]: OCPP: Received command: RemoteStartTransaction (70737472) - {"connectorId":3,"idTag":"EV-000006167"}

2025-12-02T17:06:32.690792+00:00 [FW080005G1] sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/98f22f472b97[827]: RemoteStartTransaction:
cable not yet connected
Please let us know if with this information we can close the ticket. We really appreciate your help and look forward to getting this sorted out soon!
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Guilherme Andre De Verissimo Dias
